title: Understanding Residuals
text: The residuals in a linear regression model are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. Think about how centering the data might affect these residuals.

text: What is the mean of the residuals in a linear regression model with an intercept term?

title: Effect of Centering on Coefficients
text: Consider how centering the data affects the coefficients in the regression model. Does it change the intercept or the slope?

text: Does centering the data affect the intercept term in a linear regression model?
